reassurance.title: Immediate Action: Golden Hour Fund Freeze
reassurance.message: We understand how stressful this is, but taking immediate action gives the best chance of freezing your stolen funds. Under the Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting System (CFCFRMS), calling Helpline 1930 enables banks and payment aggregators to put an immediate lien on beneficiary accounts if reported promptly.
immediate_steps: Call the National Cyber Crime Helpline **1930** immediately to report the transaction ID (UTR).
Contact your bank's 24/7 fraud helpline and request an urgent transaction block/chargeback.
Keep your UPI app, SMS alerts, and bank transaction reference ready.
